envoy.label: Send gifts
envoy.description: An envoy carries gifts. Their opinion of you rises (less so the more they already like you).

trade.label: Propose trade agreement
trade.description: Both sides earn wealth every day, more for each district where your borders touch and each Market you own. Needs a connection: your territories must touch, or you both need a Market.

pact.label: Propose non-aggression pact
pact.description: Neither side can raid, agitate against or declare war on the other while it holds. You can pay in wealth, food or materials.

alliance.label: Propose defensive alliance
alliance.description: If either of you is attacked, the other joins the war. Includes a non-aggression pact.

vassalage.label: Demand vassalage
vassalage.description: A much weaker faction (under 40% of your strength) accepts your protection: it pays you 20% of its income and joins your wars. Factions that don't feel threatened value their independence.

integrate.label: Integrate vassal
integrate.description: Merge a loyal vassal of at least a year into your faction: its land, crew and stores become yours. Costs more for bigger vassals.

tribute.label: Pay tribute
tribute.description: Hand over food or materials (whichever you can better spare) and they leave you alone for 60 days. They always take it. Only for a faction that raided you or demanded tribute in the last 90 days; the price grows with their strength.

demand.label: Demand tribute
demand.proposal: that you pay tribute or be raided
demand.description: Tell a neighbour to pay you food or materials. If they pay, you promise not to raid them for 60 days. If they refuse, your raids on them get +20% odds for 60 days. Weaker factions give in more easily.
